interpretation_limits: A covering proposal requires IoU>=.5 with any annotated same-category instance.
The positive partition identifies mathematical evaluation bottlenecks, not a causal proof about learned representations.
Resolved RGB outlines and selected patch counts do not imply correct object segmentation or semantic correspondence.
Fixed-grid controls vary proposal source and coverage; their results do not isolate just one representation mechanism.
Changed natural appearance, clutter, shape, texture, pose and category-instance variation occur together.
Natural-category transfer differs from synthetic micro-pattern identification; percentages are not directly equivalent tasks.
Figure enrollment reproduces recorded crop, OpenCV resize, median perimeter fill and padding without model inference.
